listenings.text: Welcome to the United States. Please listen to this short message before you come to the desk. Have your passport open, and take off your hat and your sunglasses. Families with small children can stay together at the same desk. The officer asks you some simple questions: why you are here, how long you stay, and the address where you sleep. Please answer only the question. You do not need long sentences. If you do not understand, say sorry, I don't understand, and the officer repeats it more slowly. This is normal, and it is not a problem. Thank you.

Hello, this is a message for passengers from flight BA two four seven. Your bags are on belt number four, on level one. Take the stairs on your left, or the elevator, if you are with children. If a bag does not arrive, do not leave the airport. Go to the baggage desk, next to belt number one, and show your ticket and the small paper from your check-in. Somebody there speaks English very slowly for visitors. After you take your bags, follow the green sign if you have nothing to declare. Thank you, and welcome.

extra_audio.text: Good morning. Here is my passport. I am here on vacation. We stay for two weeks. The address is the Park Hotel, in London. Thank you.

reading.rtitle: Before You Come to the Desk -- Arrivals, Terminal 5
paras: Welcome. Please read this while you wait in the line. It takes two minutes and it makes everything faster.

Have your passport open at the photo page. Take off your hat and your sunglasses, because the officer needs to see your face. Families with small children stay together at the same desk, so you do not need to separate.

The officer asks you three or four simple questions. Why are you here? How long do you stay? What is the address of your hotel? Do you have anything to declare? Please answer only the question. Short answers are correct and polite here: yes, I am; no, I'm not; two weeks; the Park Hotel.

If you do not understand a question, say sorry, I don't understand, and the officer says it again, more slowly. This happens every day and it is not a problem. After the desk, follow the sign to the bags, and then take the green exit if you have nothing to declare.

choices: To tell you what the officer asks and how to answer
To explain how to buy a ticket to London
To give the rules for the bags on the plane
